explanation: policy.ts adds NOMINAL_P_CUTOFF and significanceTier ('fdr' | 'nominal' | 'none'), a display label beneath isFdrSignificant; the FDR call itself is unchanged. listingModeStore.ts holds the global, localStorage-backed listing choice ('nominal' default, or 'fdr'), modelled on chartScaleStore, and ListingModeToggle.tsx renders its segmented control plus QTerm, an abbr carrying Q_EXPLANATION (what q is) for every q / FDR / padj column. The listing changes what the views list, never what counts as significant. StatisticsView's callout explains the nominal tier in search and both reports and names the toggle.
